task_spec: PR: add concurrent money transfer (transfer.py) and a background audit reconciliation sweep (audit.py), both guarding the shared account/audit state with the global locks in locks.py.

bugs.description: transfer() acquires accounts_lock THEN audit_lock; reconcile() (on a background thread) acquires audit_lock THEN accounts_lock. Opposite ordering of the same two locks is a classic AB-BA deadlock: if transfer holds accounts_lock while reconcile holds audit_lock, both block forever. Neither file is wrong alone and no comment declares a lock order -- catching it requires comparing the two acquisition orders across files.

provenance.note: CROSS-FILE INVARIANT: each function is locally correct; the deadlock exists only in the RELATIONSHIP between two files' lock-acquisition orders. No stated contract.
